caseName: Buckles v. Peoples Gas Light & Coke Co.
caseNameFull: BUCKLES Et Al. v. PEOPLES GAS LIGHT & COKE CO.
attorneys: Stanley B. Balbach for appellants., Clarence H. Ross for appellee.

opinions.text:
Per Curiam.

The motion to dismiss is granted and the appeal is dismissed. Treating the papers whereon the appeal was taken as a petition for writ of certiorari, certiorari is denied.
